scope: local macOS ARM64 AionCore v0.1.55 bundle diagnostics

attempts.failure: acp.prepare returned ENOENT after Node export
attempts.rootCause: The relative default data directory produced a relative managed npm path; changing the child working directory made the executable resolve below the staging directory.
attempts.disposition: Fixed by 4f5dea094632e6399c30c28aa6a63016d0b2d842. Partial output retained as managed-input.

attempts.failure: Codex ACP smoke test duplicated the relative staging project path
attempts.rootCause: The smoke process used the relative staging project as its working directory and also passed the same relative prefix in the entrypoint path.
attempts.disposition: Fixed by ccde99f375aacfc324f82624b5970dd70eb7e211. Partial output retained as managed-input-attempt-2.

attempts.result: Exported and validated Node 24.11.0, Codex ACP 1.1.2, Claude ACP 0.58.1, and managed-resources/manifest.json.

attempts.failure: Managed npm and node_modules links were rejected by the no-symlink output policy
attempts.rootCause: The exported Node and npm trees legitimately contain internal relative links, while the final verifier correctly forbids links in shipped output.
attempts.disposition: Fixed by 69d59e4c5f21ed3274d69b492088c704c60581f0. Assembly now materializes only links resolving to regular files inside the input root and rejects escaping, broken, or directory links.

attempts.failure: Manifest builtAt was later than the runner audit time
attempts.disposition: Payload and verifier were green, but the artifact is inadmissible and retained as aioncore-0.1.55-aarch64-apple-darwin-attempt-2.

attempts.evidenceLimit: Local diagnostic only. Final release evidence still requires native two-target workflow artifacts, archived-bundle extraction and reverification, checksummed logs, and independent review.

attempts.result: Exported and validated the managed Node and ACP resources, then added OfficeCLI v1.0.143 from the pinned HTTPS asset with exact SHA-256 2f158d46f9b6c5eb0dfe4eb02038114001e17acc47b67347417c56dcf9659096.

attempts.failure: tar started before the silently running assembler had atomically published work/bundle and created a zero-byte rejected archive
attempts.rootCause: The long-running assembler returned an execution-session identifier that was not retained by the first orchestration call. The premature archive check raced the still-active assembler; the assembler later completed successfully.
attempts.disposition: The zero-byte archive remains retained with SHA-256 e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855. No release identity uses it. The complete bundle was independently verified before a separately named archive attempt.

attempts.failure: Atomic replacement refused because work/bundle already existed and was non-empty
attempts.disposition: The first assembler had completed. The retry did not replace the immutable output; its raw log SHA-256 is 0d2fdc1d87e3c6d6b65c48dd937df30985dd28679fe17824485d304ae3e616f5.

attempts.evidenceLimit: Local macOS diagnostic only. The archive name is deliberately non-release and cannot substitute for authorized native workflow assets.
